artifacts.summary: Five-phase lean4 plan: MinusExt extension calculus with soundness engine, per-class Sigma_fc soundness rows and strictness over TM-, conditional completeness via chain bundles with ChainComplete as an explicit never-asserted hypothesis, L- deduction layer with box-globality derivations, and wiring/docs/C14 pins plus the paper footnote hand-off.

memory_candidates.content: Conditional completeness for an H/G-language Hilbert extension over task-frame semantics can be machine-checked in two lines without formalizing pure tense logic: define ChainValidIn fc phi (valid on every disjoint union of D-chains whose flow frame is in fc, box universal) and ChainComplete fc Ax := forall phi, ChainValidIn fc phi -> MinusExt fc Ax phi; then TMFrag fc phi -> ChainValidIn fc phi follows from tmFrag_sound plus the contrapositive of not_minusValidIn_of_not_chainSat (Conservativity/ChainBundleTruth.lean), and MinusExt fc Ax = TMFrag fc holds given ChainComplete. The whole classical content (Burgess 1984, Venema 2001, universal-modality reduction via MF+TR+S5) sits inside the hypothesis, which is never asserted, so the tree's forward-conservativity prohibition is respected. Same shape as tmMinusComplete_iff_forward's engine-as-hypothesis pattern.
